families.name: Truly irregular
families.blurb: No pattern. Learn these first, they are the most used verbs in Spanish.

verbs.note: hay = "there is / there are", the impersonal form. The auxiliary is ha: ha hablado.

families.name: Irregular yo
families.blurb: Regular everywhere except the yo form, which usually gains a g.

families.name: Stem change e to ie
families.blurb: The e in the stem becomes ie, except in nosotros and vosotros.

families.name: Stem change o to ue
families.blurb: The o in the stem becomes ue, except in nosotros and vosotros.

families.name: Stem change e to i
families.blurb: The e in the stem becomes i, except in nosotros and vosotros.

corrections.why: verbecc returns the impersonal "hay" in the third-person slot. In the auxiliary paradigm the form is "ha" (ha hablado). Caught by the Wiktionary cross-check.
